_comment: Inner object of the { data: ... } envelope (diagnostics route, action=toll_fraud_state). Under cap on purpose: today_billable_seconds reconciles to the sum of billable_seconds on calls.json outbound rows started on 2026-08-29 UTC (620, one answered call from the front-desk DID), and daily_outbound_cap_cents matches settings.json's same-named column - voice_toll_fraud_state reads that same column. The cap is NOT the reason the rep cannot dial out.
